closedBody: We're finishing the checks that keep BeliefAtlas to real people. Check back soon.
title: Create an account
underage: Sorry, you need to be 18 or older to create an account.
usernameNote: Leave it blank and we'll pick one. You can change it later.
dobNote: We check it once and don't keep it. You need to be 18 or older.
phoneNote: We text it a code to confirm it is yours. Use a mobile number; internet and virtual numbers can't be used. One account per number; it is stored only as a one-way hash and never shared.
passwordNote: Without one, you sign in with a passkey or a texted code.
terms: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>terms</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. Before your first answer counts, we ask you separately how your answers may be used.

verify.title: Enter the code we texted you
verify.codeLabel: Code sent to the number ending {ending}
verify.newCode: A new code is on its way.
verify.preview: Preview: no text is sent. The code is {code}.
verify.dev: Development mode: the code is in the server log.
verify.expired: That code has expired. Start again.
